lines.t: [Intro - High Pitch Electronic Chirp & Whirring Synth]
(Chirp chirp)
(Electronic glitch)
Yeah.
Listen.
(Upbeat electro-pop beat drops)
Buried the old man deep under the floor
But a new breath is knocking at the door
They call it gravity, they think we’re gonna fall
But there’s an anchor rewriting it all
An unchained force running through the veins
A quiet revolution breaking up the reigns
We don't fit the architecture they designed
When the architecture of the soul is realigned
The world is chasing after shadows in the night
But we are stepping straight into the blinding light
No longer trembling, no longer bound
An ancient whisper turning everything around
Are you ready for the shift? (Yeah!)
U-ri-neun bit-na-ne!
Open up your eyes, let the pretense fade
Look at the canvas that His hands have made
[Chorus - THE MANIAC DROP - Total Instrument Cutout, Minimalist Sub-Bass Only]
(Beat stops completely)
(Deep sigh)
He reigns supreme over all of history.
Out from the grave, a consuming victory.
(Robotic whirring sound)
Po-gi-ha-ji-ma.
Sovereign and clean, the ultimate design.
All of the praise belongs to the Divine.
(Deep low chuckle)
[Verse 2 - Bouncy, Energetic Electro Rap]
(Upbeat bouncy beat explodes back in)
Yeah, echo the sound till the pillars start to shake
We don't need the static that the counterfeits make
Jin-ri-reul dda-ra, we are moving in the stride
An uncontained fire that you cannot hide
Every heavy fortress built of compromise
Falls to the ground when the truth begins to rise
[New Bridge - Distorted, Heavy Industrial Tension Build]
(Vocals are heavy and distorted)
The foundations are cracking.
The blueprint is absolute.
It’s not an emotion. It’s an unstoppable truth.
From the void into the order, we are shifting the space.
We are sealed, we are chosen, and we cannot erase.
(Everything cuts out... 3, 2, 1...)
[Chorus - THE MANIAC DROP - Total Instrument Cutout, Minimalist Sub-Bass Only]
(Beat stops completely)
He reigns supreme over all of history.
Out from the grave, a consuming victory.
(Robotic whirring sound)
Po-gi-ha-ji-ma.
Sovereign and clean, the ultimate design.
All of the praise belongs to the Divine.
[New Outro - Gritty, Glitchy, Heavy Fading Bass]
(Bouncy beat returns but heavier and glitchier)
U-ri-neun bit-na-ne! (We are shining!)
Absolute. Sovereign. Final.
Chan-yang-hae! (Praise!)
The victory is uncontainable.
(Bouncy beat returns but heavier and glitchier)
U-ri-neun bit-na-ne! (We are shining!)
Absolute. Sovereign. Final.
Chan-yang-hae! (Praise!)
The victory is uncontainable.
(Chirp chirp)
(Fade out on mechanical glitch)
